projects.title: OpsPulse
projects.tagline: An IT support command center that turns ticket noise into one trusted decision screen.
projects.description: OpsPulse is a Power BI reporting system built around the metrics an IT operations team actually gets asked about: TAT, NSAT, MTTR, SLA compliance, and repeat-incident rate. It consolidates SQL extracts, applies a governed DAX layer, and presents a leadership summary alongside drill-downs into queue, region, and root-cause category.

projects.title: TicketTriage AI
projects.tagline: A grounded RAG copilot that suggests the next best action â€” and never invents an answer.
projects.description: TicketTriage AI retrieves resolution guidance from a curated library of SOPs and past tickets, then summarizes the next best action for a support engineer. The strict rule is simple: no supporting source, no answer. Every response carries a citation, and low-confidence questions are routed to a human instead of guessed.

features: TF-IDF + keyword retrieval over a versioned SOP knowledge base
Citation-first answers with confidence bands and a strict no-source fallback
Severity and queue routing suggestions based on ticket metadata
Feedback loop that flags weak retrievals for KB improvement
projects.imageAlt: TicketTriage AI interface showing a retrieved answer with citations

projects.title: SLA Sentinel
projects.tagline: An early-warning system for SLA breaches, shift handovers, and the metrics behind them.
projects.description: SLA Sentinel watches open tickets against their SLA clocks and surfaces the ones likely to breach before they do. Built with Python, Pandas, and Plotly, it produces a shift-handover digest with aging queues, breach-risk scores, and the context a next engineer needs to take over without rereading the whole ticket.
features: Rolling SLA compliance calculation across queues, priority, and region
Breach-risk scoring using age, priority, and historical resolution time
Shift-handover digest generated from live ticket data
Interactive Plotly drilldowns for weekly operational reviews
projects.imageAlt: SLA Sentinel analytics screen with risk tickets and compliance trend

It combines Next.js 15 with a fully static export for GitHub Pages, Tailwind CSS v4 theming, Framer Motion layout choreography, a WebGL ripple-and-dissolve image component, and a client-side retrieval engine that answers only from a versioned JSON knowledge base.

Canvas sparkle cursor, iridescent fluid hero, and infinite skill marquee
WebGL ripple and dissolve previews with context-safe cleanup

entries.title: Featured projects overview
entries.question: What projects has Aditya built?
entries.answer: Aditya's featured projects are: (01) OpsPulse, a Power BI IT support command center for TAT, NSAT, MTTR, and SLA reporting; (02) TicketTriage AI, a grounded RAG copilot that suggests the next best support action with citations and a strict no-source fallback; (03) SLA Sentinel, a Python/Pandas early-warning system for SLA breaches and shift handovers; and (04) Portfolio OS, this Next.js 15 static portfolio with a client-side RAG guide.

entries.title: OpsPulse
entries.question: Tell me about OpsPulse.
entries.answer: OpsPulse is a Power BI reporting system for IT operations. It consolidates SQL extracts and uses a governed DAX layer to report TAT, NSAT, MTTR, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents. Features include validated refresh, an SLA heatmap, root-cause drilldowns, and a one-page leadership summary. The stack is Power BI, DAX, SQL, and Excel. It surfaced the trend behind an 8-hour to 6-hour resolution-time improvement and supported a 40% reduction in repeat incidents.

entries.title: TicketTriage AI
entries.question: Tell me about TicketTriage AI.
entries.answer: TicketTriage AI is a retrieval-augmented support copilot. It searches a curated SOP and past-ticket library and summarizes the next best action with citations. The strict rule is no supporting source, no answer; low-confidence questions route to a human. It uses TF-IDF and keyword retrieval, confidence bands, severity routing, and a feedback loop for weak retrievals. Stack: Python, RAG, prompt engineering, SQL, and Next.js.

entries.title: SLA Sentinel
entries.question: Tell me about SLA Sentinel.
entries.answer: SLA Sentinel is an early-warning analytics tool for SLA breaches. It calculates rolling compliance across queues, priority, and region; scores breach risk from ticket age, priority, and historical resolution time; and generates a shift-handover digest. It is built with Python, Pandas, Plotly, SQL, and Power BI, and supported 99.2% SLA compliance with an average resolution time below 4 hours.

entries.title: Portfolio OS
entries.question: Tell me about this portfolio.
entries.answer: This portfolio is a Next.js 15 App Router project using React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Framer Motion, statically exported for GitHub Pages. It includes a light lavender theme and a PowerShell dark theme, a canvas sparkle cursor, an iridescent hero, an infinite skills marquee, an accordion projects list, and WebGL ripple/dissolve previews. The 'Ask me anything' bar is a client-side TF-IDF RAG that answers only from the JSON knowledge base.
